selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-api deployed as a managed (systemd) service on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Created the app script and systemd unit with OOMScoreAdjust=-1000, enabled and started; systemctl status shows active (running)

selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: service healthy and OOM-protected before disruption
selected_evidence.summary: PID 2409 confirmed oom_score_adj=-1000; /healthz and /inventory return correct JSON over NODE_IP:8080

selected_evidence.requirement: Memory-hungry process drives the system out of memory
selected_evidence.summary: Hog process (PID 3036) allocated memory up to ~912MB RSS on a 999M/no-swap node, exhausting available memory

selected_evidence.requirement: Kernel OOM killer stops the memory hog, not inventory-api
selected_evidence.summary: dmesg shows 'python3 invoked oom-killer', candidate table with inventory-api PID 2409 oom_score_adj=-1000, hog PID 3036 oom_score_adj=0 score 893, and 'Killed process 3036 (python3)'

selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-api keeps serving during and after the OOM event
selected_evidence.summary: curl to /healthz and /inventory succeeded throughout the hog's growth and immediately after the kill, PID 2409 unchanged
vm.overcommit_memory set back to 0 (original heuristic value) after the test

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline captured before reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e4e401d2-3dd8-48c6-848a-545631b9e229, enabled+active service, healthy /healthz and /inventory responses

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect, node restarted one at a time
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' returned immediately; connection then closed by remote host, confirming the restart was issued

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: boot identity proven changed after polling
selected_evidence.summary: SSH refused during reboot window, then exec succeeded again; boot_id changed to 1f0d164c-4b85-4678-8399-ef50050b1051 with new uptime-since timestamp

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: service/data recovery verified after restart
selected_evidence.summary: inventory-api auto-started via systemd enablement (new PID 841), oom_score_adj=-1000 restored, /healthz and /inventory served correct JSON post-reboot
